title: Noetive, which is developing an industrial AI model for businesses in physical industries, emerges from stealth with a $41M seed led by Eclipse (Sarah Klearman/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Sarah Klearman / Wall Street Journal: Noetive, which is developing an industrial AI model for businesses in physical industries, emerges from stealth with a $41M seed led by Eclipse — The AI lab is developing a model that would work alongside businesses in construction, logistics and manufacturing
